compatibilityNote: Codex currently triggers the fixed 8x9 core atlas states only. These extended states are bonus assets and trigger semantics for future app integrations or custom wrappers.

extendedStates.purpose: 用户长时间没有操作时进入趴睡/休眠表现。
extendedStates.suggestedTrigger: No user interaction for 10 minutes or more.

extendedStates.purpose: 短时间空闲后开始犯困，但还没有完全睡着。
从休眠状态被用户唤醒时的起身动画。
extendedStates.suggestedTrigger: User input while long-idle-sleep is active.

extendedStates.purpose: 轻松娱乐状态，结合跳跃和挥手。
extendedStates.suggestedTrigger: User opens pet menu or triggers a fun interaction.

extendedStates.purpose: 开心时左右摇摆的娱乐表现。
extendedStates.suggestedTrigger: Positive user feedback or playful interaction.

extendedStates.purpose: 任务完成或成功时的开心庆祝动作。
等待太久时的无聊站姿，和普通 waiting 区分。
extendedStates.suggestedTrigger: Waiting for user input for more than 2 minutes.

extendedStates.purpose: 用户悬停或打开相关面板时的观察状态。
extendedStates.suggestedTrigger: Pointer hover, inspection, or side panel activity.

extendedStates.purpose: 长任务执行时的专注工作状态。
extendedStates.suggestedTrigger: Long-running local or cloud task is active.

extendedStates.purpose: 从屏幕边缘或小窗口探头看的趣味状态。
extendedStates.suggestedTrigger: Pet is tucked near an edge or summoned briefly.
